summary: The five fields of a dispatch packet, as a sub-agent brief carries them.

fields.label: MISSION
fields.says: what to do, in one or two sentences

fields.label: GROUND
fields.says: the facts it stands on, as pointers

fields.label: BOUNDARIES
fields.says: what it may not touch or decide

fields.label: RETURN
fields.says: the artifact that ends the run
